faq.title: FAQs
faq.answer1: Chat Smith is an AI assistant that helps you research, write, analyze, and automate tasks through natural, conversational prompts
faq.question2: What can I do with Chat Smith?
faq.answer2:
- Draft, edit, and translate text and emails
- Summarize articles, PDFs, and meetings
- Brainstorm ideas and create outlines or presentations
- Answer questions and find sources
- Write, review, and debug code
- Analyze data or spreadsheets and create charts
- Create templates and automate repetitive workflow
faq.question3: Where can I access Chat Smith?
faq.answer3:
- On the web (any browser)
- Mobile apps (iOS and Android)
- Optional browser extension for quick use while you browse
faq.question4: Who is Chat Smith designed for?
faq.answer4:
- Students, freelancers, and creators
- Professionals in marketing, sales, operations, customer support, and engineering
- Teams that want faster research, content creation, and documentation
faq.question5: What AI models power Chat Smith?
faq.answer5: Chat Smith uses a mix of state-of-the-art large language models chosen for quality, speed, and cost, including top commercial models (e.g., GPT‑4‑class and Claude‑class models) and strong open‑source models (e.g., Llama/Mistral families). Models are routed automatically per task and are updated over time. Your content isn't used to train base models unless you opt in.
